annotations.title: Relational Schema Normalization Auditor (3NF, BCNF) & Integrity Guard

description: Audits database schemas for third normal form (3NF) compliance, transitive dependencies, and missing foreign key constraints. Use when reviewing database architectures, preventing update anomalies, or validating relational integrity; for detecting breaking schema migrations, use detect_breaking_migrations instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('target_normal_form' defaults to 'third_normal_form_3nf'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining table columns, primary keys, and relations.

strict_keys.description: Whether to enforce explicit foreign key constraints on all ID references.

target_normal_form.description: Target normalization standard: 3NF, Boyce-Codd BCNF, or denormalized OLAP star.

name: validate_schema_normalization

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for validate_schema_normalization.

conforms_to_target.description: True if the schema strictly satisfies the chosen normal form requirements.

normalization_score.description: Schema relational design quality score on a 0 to 100 scale.

redundancies_flagged.description: List of redundant fields, missing primary keys, or transitive dependencies identified.

refactoring_suggestions.description: Specific table decomposition and foreign key recommendations to achieve compliance.

title: Relational Schema Normalization Auditor (3NF, BCNF) & Integrity Guard
